dispatches.text: March, AD 68. Word comes from Gaul: Julius Vindex, governor of Lugdunensis, has risen against Nero.

Nero is dead. Abandoned by the Praetorians, he took his own life outside Rome. The Senate rules, for now.

story.title: The end of Aulus Vitellius
text: Vitellius is dead. He was, men say, a man who could not be emperor and would not be anything less.
His legions are looking for a new master.

event.title: Brigands in the hills
event.text: Brigands hold the roads of Northern Italy. Merchants will not travel, and the tax carts are robbed.

storyLog.title: A man from Vindex
storyLog.choice: Send him back with friendly words
storyLog.text: He goes back to Vindex with your good wishes and nothing else.

storyLog.title: Deserters
storyLog.text: They take the oath again, to you this time.

storyLog.title: The bankers of the province
